glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: Here we explain words from the app in plain language.

anamnesis.explanation: These are the questions at the start. For example, you tell us your sport, your level and whether you have pain.

fitnessLevel.explanation: This shows how fit you are: Beginner, Advanced or Pro. You choose it in the questions at the start.

seasonPhase.explanation: This is the part of your season: off-season, preparation or competition. The app adapts your training to it.

trainingPlan.explanation: This is your plan for several weeks. The app creates it from your answers.

trainingDay.explanation: This is a weekday on which you train. You set how long and where.

trainingPlace.explanation: This is where you train: at home, in the gym, in the hall or outside. The app picks exercises that fit the equipment.

focusTraining.explanation: This is a short workout of 10 to 20 minutes. It is independent of your plan and practices one thing, such as stable legs.

preventionTraining.explanation: This is a short workout for your pains, for example in the knee or shoulder. It helps you avoid injuries.

hypertrophy.explanation: Here your muscles grow. You train with medium weight and more repetitions.

maxStrength.explanation: Here you train with heavy weights and few repetitions. It is available from age 16 for Advanced and Pro athletes.

explosivePower.explanation: Here you train fast and strong movements, such as jumps.

powerEndurance.explanation: Here you repeat strong movements many times in a row. You hold your strength for longer.

warmUp.explanation: This is how you warm up at the start. Your body gets warm and ready for training.

coolDown.explanation: This is the stretching at the end. Your body calms down again.

mobility.explanation: These are exercises for flexible joints. Afterwards you can move more freely.

foamRoller.explanation: You massage your muscles yourself with the roller or a ball. This loosens tension.

legAxisStability.explanation: This is the control over your legs in jumps and landings. Your knees stay stable.

fullBodyStability.explanation: These are exercises for your trunk and your whole body. You stand and move more safely.

repetition.explanation: You do the movement once. For example, one squat is one repetition.

set.explanation: This is one round of an exercise, with several repetitions or a fixed time. Then you rest.

muscleSoreness.explanation: Your muscles hurt after training. You mark the spots before training, and the mark is valid for 24 hours.

strengthTest.explanation: You lift a weight as often as you can, and the app estimates your maximum strength from it. The test is available from age 16.
